novelty_flags.label: oeq:uniform-changing-support
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits closer uniform LP-inference comparators ChoRussell2023 and Gafarov2025; both should be distinguished from the proposed paired shrinking-margin transport procedure.

soundness_flags.label: def:uniform-handle / oeq:uniform-changing-support
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposed failure construction is required to use the stated step window (nκ_n)^(-1/2)=o(t_n)=o(κ_n), but that window itself implies nκ_n^3→∞, so it cannot govern the bounded-nκ_n^3 failure branch without separately specifying the alternative tuning/procedure quantified there.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:uniform-changing-support
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform bounded-Lipschitz Gaussian approximation and conditional multiplier approximation are assumed rather than derived from a primitive sampling theorem.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline is conditional on those two uniform primitive approximations over a separately defined rare-cell experiment class.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article states that numerical-derivative inference is consistent for directionally differentiable functions with suitable step sizes and uniformly valid for certain convex Lipschitz functions.

The paper proves pointwise root-n LP-value inference, an impossibility of unrestricted uniform consistency, and uniform consistency under its δ-condition; it explicitly leaves uniform inference under further regularity for future work.
The paper proposes uniformly valid inference for linear functionals of parameters defined by linear moment inequalities via perturbed LP value functions.
The article develops uniformly valid confidence sets for sharp identified-set subvectors in finite affine models, including nonregular flat-face settings.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Split the rare-cell law class from the candidate sufficient-regime class, then state the failure theorem with an explicit quantifier over admissible step schedules (or one concrete below-boundary schedule).

Add Cho--Russell and Gafarov as direct comparators, explaining why their affine-moment/regularized LP procedures neither imply nor rule out simultaneous coverage for this paired transport-endpoint numerical derivative.

Specify whether sharpness means failure for every row-feasible numerical-delta step, minimax impossibility for all confidence procedures, or failure of one named implementation; prove the matching 2×2 statement at that level.

recommended_next_step: Revise the headline’s below-boundary procedure/tuning quantifiers and expand the uniform-LP prior-art comparison, then continue this field-tier angle.
